reuse.reason: The official brand plugin registers nothing outside the official build profile, so SidebarRoot renders its fallbacks. Occupying only the public sidebar.brand.name slot replaces the display text; the official mark fallback (FishLogo with its click-to-copy version), layout and interaction stay untouched. No official source is copied, forked or replaced.
gaps: User-approved (2026-11-13): the sidebar shows the code name `dsh-base` in every locale; the product display name `DeepSeek Harness Base` is used in README and documentation.

Unavoidable: the official name fallback renders the version line and click-to-copy version inside that slot, so occupying it removes them; the official mark fallback and the Settings version row remain.
